thread:
alex: Hey folks — PTAL, I addressed the review comments on #4523, rebased onto main, and pushed a small DB migration. CI is green locally and on the PR. I need two approvals before scheduling a canary.

alex: Migration note: creates an index on users(email). It's implemented as a background job for Postgres: 
```sql
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_email ON users (email);
```
I also added a feature-flag toggle `enable_new_matching` default=false so we can flip without rollback.

alex: Concern: adding the index could take a while for large tables. Plan is to run the index build during the low-traffic maintenance window and monitor locks. If anyone has safer suggestions, speak up.

alex: Release note draft included in the PR description. Also updated the migration docs with the exact `psql` command I ran: 
```
-- run from primary during maintenance window
psql -h primary-prod -d redwood -c "CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_users_email ON users (email);"
```

maya: skimmed — looks good overall. one tiny nit: can we add a DEBUG log when the migration job starts/completes? helps for post-mortem. otherwise LGTM :+1:

juan: I'll do a deeper review in ~2 hours (in a meeting rn). Quick question: does the new index affect writes/replication in any known way?

alex: Good question — index creation is async and shouldn't affect normal writes except the usual bloat/IO. replication lag could spike briefly; that's why maintenance window. I added a note to the runbook to watch `replication_lag_seconds`.

sam: added :eyes: and left a small inline comment about a nil-check in matcher.go — should be quick.

ci-bot: CI passed — all checks green (unit, lint, integration).

deploy-bot: FYI — to schedule the canary you need 2 approvals and no blocking labels.

alex: @maya and @juan can you PTAL for approvals? If both approve I'll schedule the canary for tonight's 01:00 UTC window and notify infra. I can also drop the index creation into a separate ops-only run if you'd prefer.

maya: I can approve after adding the debug log — will push a tiny commit in a few mins.

juan: Thumbs up, approve once maya's commit is in. I'll double-check the rollback steps.

sam: approved too on the nil-check comment fix. good to go from my side.

alex: Thanks — I'll merge after the extra commit and then ping deploy to book the window. Will add an explicit rollback snippet to the runbook: `DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_users_email;`

alex: also adding a quick smoke test to the canary checklist to exercise the matching endpoint and validate response times.

alex: tagging this as ready-for-canary after commits landed. Thanks everyone!

juan: nice, thanks.

maya: done — pushed the debug log commit and approved.

alex: merging in 5 if no objections.

sam: no objections from me.

ci-bot: Build triggered on merge — monitor pipeline for canary deploy.

alex: merging now, will follow up with deploy scheduling + runbook link.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-18T01:00:00Z (maintenance window). Notifying oncall.

alex: noted, thanks.
